Hi Marta —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a proposed trial charter so we can get aligned and pull together an SOW. High level: RetailX wants an in-store Q&A assistant (English/Spanish/French) and a fallback plan for edge cases + low-latency responses for POS devices.

Proposed 3-week trial (staging environment):
- Week 0 (kickoff): data & access, instrumentation, success metric baseline
- Week 1: focused prompts + core flows (search, product Q&A, returns)
- Week 2: multilingual load + edge-case stress testing, quality evaluation

Success criteria (pass/fail thresholds):
- Accuracy: >= 85% intent-match on the curated prompt set (50 prompts per locale)
- Latency: p95 < 450ms when routed to dedicated pool under expected load
- Cost: average token cost below the target we discussed (estimate in SOW)
- Safety/regulatory: no PII leakage in 100 random transcripts and privacy appendix review

Model picks (recommended):
- Primary: Llama-3-13B-chat (quantized q4f) — best balance for multilingual handling and latency on our dedicated pool
- Fallback: MPT-7B-Chat (instruction-tuned) — used if we hit capacity or for low-memory edge nodes

Why this pair: Llama-3-13B-chat gives better instruction following on product-style Q&A and is stronger in Spanish/French; MPT-7B is cheaper to run and robust as a failover. We will enable prefix/KV caching and a locale-aware routing policy.

Owners:
- Trial lead (orchestration): Priyom Das (internal)
- Success manager (post-trial handoff): Laura Bennett (internal)
- Pricing / SOW / contract: Ben Carter (internal)

Attachments: attached draft SOW and privacy appendix for initial procurement review.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Marta: confirm scope & locales to include (English + Spanish + French?) — by Mon 07/02
2) RetailX procurement: confirm PO process & billing contact — by Mon 07/02
3) Redwood: send SOW draft + initial estimate (attached) — by EOD today

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m call if you want to walk through the charter.

—Chloe
